summary.text: Raphael Warnock was elected to the U.S. Senate from Georgia in 2021 and won a full six-year term in December 2022; his office describes him as Georgia's first Black Senator.

paragraphs.text: He has been Senior Pastor of Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta since 2005.
He was raised in public housing in Savannah, Georgia, attended Morehouse College, and received his doctorate from Union Theological Seminary.
